g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
g.text: # 1. Unauthorized employee queries a protected document (SQL ACL filter before LLM context)
# 2. Admin grants READ permission on document → immediate cited answer
$ grant_acl USER $EMP_ID READ && ask_as_employee "设备保修期是多久？"
{"found": true, "answer": "整机保修期为 24 个月...", "sources": ["sample_faq.md#chunk-2"]}
# 3. Out-of-scope question → deterministic refusal instead of hallucination
$ ask_as_admin "公司明年的股权计划是什么？"
• corpus-v1 (28 docs, 57 Qs): 44/45 answerable · 12/12 refusals · 0 ACL leaks
• Shipped quality gate: 11/12 across 8 consecutive runs · golden 19/20 · stress 8/8
